issues.description: Rideable.messageOnRide signature contradicts the specification. The UML/problem statement defines Rideable with a no-argument method `messageOnRide(): String` and instructs returning `"Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"`. The solution instead declares `String messageOnRide(String equipment)` in Rideable and implements that parameterized method in Pig and Seal, which conflicts with the required interface and would break student code written to the statement (and the provided Main example that calls `messageOnRide()` without arguments).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the statement/UML: change `Rideable` to `String messageOnRide();` and update `Pig`/`Seal` to implement `messageOnRide()` returning exactly `"Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"` (no extra parameter). If an equipment parameter is intended, update the UML, text (including the required return format), and the Main example accordingly.
